title: INGEST Authorship Record
description: The declared relationship between a published artifact and the human whose name is on it. An artifact takes the weakest true class. An undeclared class is malformed, not a default.

traceEntry.description: Either a certified source reference, or a declaration that the author composed this directly.

locator.description: Which passage of the artifact this covers, at the declared granularity.

class.description: curated: every sentence traces to certified source or direct composition, machine assembly and mechanical editing only. assisted: machine help reached the sentences. generated: produced by machine from approved records.

surfaceClass.description: authored requires curated. derived and operational accept generated. Publishing below a surface's floor is IN-15.

traceGranularity.description: Coarser is permitted and must be stated. An undeclared granularity is IN-14 and invites a reader to assume the finest one.

tracePath.description: Required when class is curated or assisted.

disclosure.description: Required when class is assisted or generated. Must be visible where a reader encounters the artifact.

embeds.description: Authorship ids of embedded artifacts. The containing artifact takes the weakest class present.
